paragraphs.source_en: Just then footsteps sounded nearby in the corridor, followed by the sound of a sliding paper door opening. Who could have come? I listened with all my might, and it turned out to be the voice of a maid: “Miss, the master and mistress are calling for you.” “I don’t care.” The young lady snapped her first rebuff at her. “The master and mistress say they have something to discuss and want you to come.” “How annoying. I told you I don’t care!” The young lady dealt the maid a second rebuff. The quick-witted maid tried to soothe her temper and said, “I hear it is about Kangetsu that they want you.” “Kangetsu or Suigetsu, I want nothing to do with it! I simply loathe him, with that foolish-looking face of his.” Poor Kangetsu received the young lady’s third rebuff behind his back. The young lady suddenly said, “Oh, when did you put your hair up?” The maid breathed a sigh of relief and answered as simply as possible, “Today.” “A mere maid, and so conceited.” The young lady turned her attack and gave her a fourth rebuff. “And besides, why have you changed into a new kimono collar?” “Yes, miss. You gave it to me before, and because it was too fine, I felt it would be wasteful to wear it and kept it in my trunk. The one I had been wearing was so dirty that I put this one on instead.” “When did I ever give you such a thing?” “This New Year, when you went to Shirokiya and bought it: a deep olive-brown one dyed with a sumo ranking list. You said the pattern was too subdued for you and gave it to me. It is that kimono collar.” “Oh, how infuriating! It actually suits you quite well. I hate that.” “You are too kind, miss.” “I was not praising you. I said it was hateful.” “Yes?” “If it suited you so well, why did you accept it without saying anything?” “Yes?” “If even you can wear it and have it suit you, then surely it would not look bad on me either!” “It would certainly suit you very well, miss.” “If you knew perfectly well that it would suit me, why did you quietly take it for yourself? And then you wear it so calmly. What a nasty person you are!” She fired off rebuke after rebuke at the maid. Just as I was listening reverently to see how this situation would develop, Kaneda called loudly to the young lady from the drawing room across the way: “Tomiko! Tomiko!” The young lady had no choice but to answer, “Yes,” and left the telephone room. The little Japanese spaniel, somewhat larger than I, whose eyes and mouth seemed squeezed into the very center of its face, followed close behind her. As usual, I went on tiptoe out through the kitchen to the street and hurried back to my master’s house. It may be said that this expedition was an unqualified success.

paragraphs.source_en: When I returned home, the sudden move from a fine house to a filthy place gave me the feeling of having passed abruptly from a sunny mountaintop into a dim, dark cave. During the expedition my mind had been taken up with other things, so I had paid no attention at all to the house’s decoration, partitions, or sliding paper doors. Yet once I felt how lowly my own dwelling was, I could not help longing for that mansion’s very ordinariness. It seems, after all, that a businessman is superior to a teacher. I myself found this thought rather strange, so, as usual, I consulted my tail; and from its tip came the oracle: “Quite right, quite right!” When I went back into the sitting room, to my surprise, Mr. Meitei had still not gone home. A number of cigarette butts stood stuck upright in the brazier, just like a honeycomb. Meitei sat cross-legged and was discoursing on something. At some point even young Kangetsu had arrived. My master lay there with his arm for a pillow, gazing intently at the rain stain on the ceiling. As always, it was a gathering of easygoing idlers at peace with the world.

paragraphs.source_zh: 回到家，由于从一座漂亮房子突然挪到肮脏的地方来，我产生了一种仿佛从一座阳光温煦的山顶突然进入一个黑咕隆咚的洞穴里来的感觉。在探险中，由于心思专注在别的事物上，那屋子的装饰、纸隔断、纸拉门到底是个什么样子，我根本没有留意。可是，当我一旦感到我这住处十分低级的时候，不由得留恋起那所宅子的平庸来了。看来，似乎实业家还是比教员了不起。我自己也觉得这种想法奇怪，照例请教了一下我的尾巴，可尾巴尖儿昭示说：“你想得对，你想得对！”当我回到客厅里，令人吃惊的是，迷亭先生还没有走。许多烟蒂竖在火盆里，活像个蜂窝。迷亭盘膝而坐，正在讲什么。不知何时寒月君也来了。我家主人枕着胳膊躺在那里，专心致志地瞧着顶棚上的雨渍。一如往常，还是太平逸民的聚会。
